issue.title: http upload example with HttpObjectAggregator

repository.name: netty
repository.description: Netty project - an event-driven asynchronous network application framework

issue.body:
I tried to change the HttpUploadServerInitializer class to use HttpObjectAggregator in the pipeline and I couldn't successfully upload a file.  

I get the right content-length but fileUpload.getString() contains only blanks.

I pulled the latest netty-master as of 2013-08-08.

Here is the output I get.
